A car bomb attack in central Colombia injures 25 people. The incident took place in the capital of Meta province. It happened on the eve of the 10th anniversary of Colombia's landmark peace accord with FARC Guerrillas. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack so far. Hem Kaur Saroya explains on Vantage.
